title: 四六级写作万能句型手册

sections.name: 开篇引题 · 万能开头

items.s: With the rapid development of society, ... has become a heated topic among the general public.
items.c: 随着社会的快速发展，……已成为大众热议的话题。

items.s: Nowadays, there is a growing awareness that...
items.c: 如今，人们越来越意识到……

items.s: Recently, the issue of ... has aroused wide public concern.
items.c: 近来，……的问题引起了公众的广泛关注。

items.s: When it comes to ..., opinions vary from person to person.
items.c: 谈到……，人们观点各不相同。

items.s: It is universally acknowledged that ... plays an increasingly important role in our daily life.
items.c: 众所周知，……在我们的日常生活中扮演着越来越重要的角色。

items.s: Nowadays, ... has become an inevitable part of modern society.
items.c: 如今，……已成为现代社会不可或缺的一部分。

items.s: With the advent of the information age, ... is changing our way of life.
items.c: 随着信息时代的到来，……正在改变我们的生活方式。

items.s: Along with the advance of science and technology, more and more people attach importance to...
items.c: 随着科技的进步，越来越多的人重视起……

items.s: There is no denying that ... has both advantages and disadvantages.
items.c: 不可否认，……既有利也有弊。

items.s: As the proverb goes, "..." This saying reveals a profound truth.
items.c: 正如谚语所说：“……”。这句话揭示了一个深刻的道理。

sections.name: 图表描述 · 数据表达

items.s: As is shown in the chart, the number of ... increased sharply from ... to ... during the past five years.
items.c: 如图所示，在过去五年里，……的数量从……急剧增长到……

items.s: According to the statistics, ... accounts for nearly 60% of the total.
items.c: 据统计，……占总数的近 60%。

items.s: The table reflects a clear trend that ... is on the rise.
items.c: 表格反映出……正呈上升趋势的清晰趋势。

items.s: By contrast, the percentage of ... dropped by 15%.
items.c: 相比之下，……的比例下降了 15%。

items.s: It can be seen from the graph that ... fluctuated slightly over the period.
items.c: 从图表可以看出，在此期间……略有波动。

items.s: The figures indicate that ... has doubled compared with that of last year.
items.c: 数据表明，……与去年相比翻了一番。

items.s: What is worth noting is that the gap between ... and ... is narrowing.
items.c: 值得注意的是，……与……之间的差距正在缩小。

items.s: The chart provides some interesting data regarding...
items.c: 该图表提供了一些有关……的有趣数据。

items.s: A close analysis of the data reveals that...
items.c: 对数据的仔细分析表明……

items.s: Such a change may be attributed to the following factors.
items.c: 这种变化可以归因于以下几个因素。

sections.name: 论证展开 · 分析说理

items.s: There are several reasons accounting for this phenomenon. Firstly, ... Secondly, ... Finally, ...
items.c: 造成这种现象的原因有几方面。首先……其次……最后……

items.s: The reasons for this are not far to seek. To begin with, ... In addition, ...
items.c: 其中的原因不难寻找。首先……此外……

items.s: It is obvious that ... contributes greatly to the development of...
items.c: 显然，……极大地促进了……的发展。

items.s: A case in point is that..., which shows the importance of...
items.c: 一个典型的例子是……，这说明了……的重要性。

items.s: What's more, ... enables us to broaden our horizons and enrich our experience.
items.c: 此外，……使我们能够开阔视野、丰富经历。

items.s: Only in this way can we solve the problem effectively.
items.c: 只有这样，我们才能有效解决这个问题。（倒装加分句型）

items.s: It is high time that we placed great emphasis on...
items.c: 现在正是我们高度重视……的时候了。

items.s: We should take effective measures to cope with the situation.
items.c: 我们应当采取有效措施应对这一局面。

items.s: As far as I am concerned, the advantages of ... far outweigh its disadvantages.
items.c: 就我而言，……的优点远大于缺点。

items.s: Every coin has two sides, and ... is no exception.
items.c: 凡事都有两面，……也不例外。

sections.name: 列举举例 · 增强说服力

items.s: Take ... for example, ...
A recent survey conducted by ... indicates that 78% of college students...
items.c: 最近由……开展的一项调查表明，78% 的大学生……

items.s: For one thing, ...; for another, ...
items.c: 一方面……；另一方面……

items.s: To illustrate, ...
items.c: 举例来说，……

items.s: Statistics from authoritative institutions demonstrate that...
items.c: 来自权威机构的数据证明……

items.s: Numerous examples can be given, but this will suffice.
items.c: 例子不胜枚举，但这个已足够说明问题。

items.s: According to a recent study, people who ... tend to ...
items.c: 根据最近的一项研究，……的人往往……

items.s: My own experience serves as a good example.
items.c: 我自己的经历就是一个很好的例子。

items.s: Such examples can be found easily in our daily life.
items.c: 这样的例子在我们的日常生活中很容易找到。

items.s: The following example may help illustrate the point.
items.c: 下面这个例子可能有助于说明这一点。

sections.name: 对比转折 · 逻辑衔接

items.s: On the one hand, ...; on the other hand, ...
items.c: 一方面……；另一方面……

items.s: However, the other side of the coin is that...
items.c: 然而，问题的另一面是……

items.s: Despite the fact that ..., ... still remains a serious problem.
items.c: 尽管……，……仍然是一个严重的问题。

items.s: While some people believe that ..., others hold the opposite view.
items.c: 虽然有人认为……，但另一些人持相反观点。

items.s: Nevertheless, we should not neglect the fact that...
items.c: 然而，我们不应忽视……的事实。

items.s: In contrast to ..., ... is more ...
items.c: 与……相比，……更加……

items.s: Admittedly, ... has its merits, but its drawbacks should not be overlooked.
items.c: 诚然，……有其优点，但其缺点也不容忽视。

items.s: Compared with ..., ... enjoys the advantage of...
items.c: 与……相比，……具有……的优势。

items.s: On the contrary, ...
items.c: 恰恰相反，……

items.s: Even so, the benefits of ... are beyond doubt.
items.c: 即便如此，……的好处是毋庸置疑的。

sections.name: 结尾升华 · 万能收束

items.s: In conclusion, ... is of great significance to both individuals and society.
items.c: 总之，……对个人和社会都具有重要意义。

items.s: To sum up, we should ... and at the same time encourage others to...
items.c: 总而言之，我们应当……，同时鼓励他人……

items.s: From what has been discussed above, we may safely arrive at the conclusion that...
items.c: 通过以上讨论，我们可以有把握地得出结论……

items.s: Only by joint efforts can we build a better future.
items.c: 只有通过共同努力，我们才能创造更美好的未来。

items.s: It is essential that effective actions should be taken to prevent the situation from worsening.
items.c: 必须采取有效行动防止情况恶化。

items.s: As long as we stick to ..., we are bound to achieve success eventually.
items.c: 只要我们坚持……，就终将取得成功。

items.s: Let us bear in mind that ... and spare no effort to...
items.c: 让我们铭记……，并不遗余力地去……

items.s: In a word, the trend of ... is irresistible in modern society.
items.c: 总之，……的趋势在现代社会是不可阻挡的。

items.s: Considering all these factors, we may reasonably come to the conclusion that...
items.c: 考虑到所有这些因素，我们可以合理地得出结论……

items.s: The future of ... lies in our hands, and it is our duty to...
items.c: ……的未来掌握在我们手中，……是我们的责任。
